final_message:
The root cause was in `recover` in `billing/dunning.py`. After an invoice was paid, it checked for other outstanding invoices, but the branch for "none left" was just `pass`. A past-due subscription was never moved back to active. That branch now calls `transition(ctx, subscription, "active")`.

The full suite passes (24 tests). I didn't add the reported test to the suite, so the pass count doesn't include it. I also wrote `answer.json` in the repository root with `{"file": "dunning.py", "function": "recover"}`.

steps.command: ls billing && wc -l billing/*.py && grep -n "past_due\|retry\|def advance" -r billing tests/conftest.py
cat billing/dunning.py; sed -n 55,105p billing/engine.py; cat billing/payments.py

python3 - <<'E'
p='billing/dunning.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("    if not outstanding:\n        pass\n","    if not outstanding:\n        transition(ctx, subscription, \"active\")\n")
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
echo '{"file": "dunning.py", "function": "recover"}' > answer.json
tail -5 billing/dunning.py; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
